MINISTRY OF RAILWAYS 
[North Eastern Railway, (Construction Organization)] 
NOTIFICATION 
Gorakhpur, the 9th July, 2025 


5.0. 3049(E).— Whereas, by the notification of the Government of India, in the Ministry of Railways (North 
Eastern Railway, Construction Origination), Notification number, S.O. 1371 (E) dated 24 March 2025 published in 
Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part I, section 3 Sub-section (ii), dated 24 March 2025 (hereinafter referred to as the 
said notification) and issued under sub-section (1) of section 20A of the Railways (Amendment) Act, 2008 (11 of 
2008) (hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the Central Government declares its intention to acquire the land 
specified in the schedule annexed to the said notification for the purpose of execution, maintenance, management and 
operation of Special Railway Project, namely Khalilabad-Bahraich New Line Railway project (240.66 km.) in Tehsil 
Bhinga of Shrawasti District in the State of Uttar Pradesh. 


And whereas, the substance of the said notification was published in daily newspapers namely 'Dainik 
jagran" and ''The Times of India" Dated 30 March 2025 under sub section (4) of section 20A of the said Act; 


And whereas, the competent Authority has resolved all the objection received in this project against the 
notification. And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section 20E of the said Act, the Competent Authority has submitted its 
report to the Central Government; 


Now therefore, upon receipt of the report of the Competent Authority, and in exercise of the powers conferred 
by sub-section (1) of section 20E of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the lands specified in 
the schedule annexed hereto shall be acquired for the aforesaid purpose; 


And further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 20E of the said Act, the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the official Gazette, the land specified in the schedule annexed 
hereto shall vest absolutely in the Central government free from all encumbrances.

MINISTRY OF RAILWAYS 
[North Eastern Railway (Construction Organization)]| 
NOTIFICATION 
New Delhi, the 9th July, 2025 


S.O. 3053(E).— Whereas, by the notification of the Government of India, in the Ministry of Railways (North 
Eastern Railway, Construction Origination), Notification number, S.O. 1074 (0) dated 03 March 2025 published in 
Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part II, section 3 Sub-section (ii), dated 03 March 2025 (hereinafter referred to as the 
said notification) and issued under sub-section (1) of section 20A of the Railways (Amendment) Act, 2008 (11 of 
2008) (hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the Central Government declares its intention to acquire the land 
specified in the schedule annexed to the said notification for the purpose of execution, maintenance, management and 
operation of Special Railway Project, namely Khalilabad-Bahraich New Line Railway project (240.66 km.) in Tehsil 
Jamunaha of Shrawasti District in the State of Uttar Pradesh. 


And whereas, the substance of the said notification was published in daily newspapers namely "Dainik 
jagran" and "The Times of India" Dated 20 March 2025 under sub section (4) of section 20A of the said Act; 


And whereas, the competent Authority has resolved all the objection received in this project against the 
notification. And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section 20E of the said Act, the Competent Authority has submitted its 
report to the Central Government; 


Now therefore, upon receipt of the report of the Competent Authority, and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by sub-section (1) of section 20E of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the lands 
specified in the schedule annexed hereto shall be acquired for the aforesaid purpose;

And further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 20E of the said Act, the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the official Gazette, the land specified in the schedule annexed 
hereto shall vest absolutely in the Central government free from all encumbrances.

MINISTRY OF RAILWAYS 
[North Eastern Railway(Construction Organization) | 
NOTIFICATION 
New Delhi, the 9th July, 2025 


S.O. 3051(E).— Whereas, by the notification of the Government of India, in the Ministry of Railways (North 
Eastern Railway, Construction Origination), Notification number, S.O. 1370 (E) dated 24 March 2025 published in 
Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part I, section 3 Sub-section (ii), dated 24 March 2025 (hereinafter referred to as the 
said notification) and issued under sub-section (1) of section 20A of the Railways (Amendment) Act, 2008 (11 of 2008) 
(hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the Central Government declares its intention to acquire the land specified in 
the schedule annexed to the said notification for the purpose of execution, maintenance, management and operation of 
Special Railway Project, namely Khalilabad-Bahraich New Line Railway project (240.66 km.) in Tehsil Ekauna of 
Shrawasti District in the State of Uttar Pradesh. 


And whereas, the substance of the said notification was published in daily newspapers namely "Dainik jagran" 
and "The Times of India" Dated 31 March 2025 under sub section (4) of section 20A of the said Act; 


And whereas, the competent Authority has resolved all the objection received in this project against the 
notification. And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section 20E of the said Act, the Competent Authority has submitted its 
report to the Central Government; 


Now therefore, upon receipt of the report of the Competent Authority, and in exercise of the powers conferred 
by sub-section (1) of section 20E of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the lands specified in the 
schedule annexed hereto shall be acquired for the aforesaid purpose; 


And further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 20E of the said Act, the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the official Gazette, the land specified in the schedule annexed hereto 
shall vest absolutely in the Central government free from all encumbrances.
